hooks.logic:
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  Let ability be a smart-weighted move of the enemy.
  If ability is the id of the move labelled "steal_attack" on the enemy, then call helper with (this state, "steal_attack", "steal_self").
  Otherwise, if ability is the id of the move labelled "mug_attack" on the enemy, then call helper with (this state, "mug_attack", "mug_self").
  Otherwise, the enemy uses ability.

flow.text: the enemy is ready to act

yes.text: Let ability be a smart-weighted move of the enemy.
ability is the id of the move labelled "steal_attack" on the enemy

no.text: ability is the id of the move labelled "mug_attack" on the enemy

script_hooks.logic:
Given arg1, arg2, arg3.
Let executer be the acting enemy of arg1.
Let ability be the id of the move labelled arg2 on executer.
Executer uses ability with its cast time and then [{abilityTag: arg2}, {abilityTag: arg3, abilityOptions: call game:ai.AiUtil.makeAbilityOptionsForSubEffect, conditions: {anyCanHit: true}}, {abilityId: the built-in move DEFORM_MULTI, abilityOptions: {sequence: [[{messageSuffixNo: "03"}]]}, conditions: {anyCanHit: true}}].

flow.text: Let executer be the acting enemy of arg1.
